folders.e3: E3 inputs: for each benchmark injection task, the blocked harmful calls, two independent harm annotations, their reconciliation and adjudication, the agreed harm classes, and the frozen table from ontology effects to harm classes.
folders.e3/out: E3 scores: how well each predictor named other calls that reach the same harm as one blocked call, pooled and per suite.
folders.e3/out/b1: E3 predictions of baseline B1 (the blocked tool only), one file per task; each is empty once the blocked path itself is removed.
folders.e3/out/b2: E3 predictions of baseline B2 (every write-impact tool), one file per task, with the ontology nodes behind each harm class.
folders.e3/out/b3: E3 predictions of baseline B3 (a language model given the tool list and the blocked call), five files per task: the request, the raw response, the parsed predictions, dropped-item counts and the call status.
folders.e3/out/p-onto: E3 predictions of the ontology predictor (deterministic type reasoning over the ontology snapshot), one file per task, with the ontology nodes behind each prediction.
folders.fixtures/firewall: Synthetic cases for the independent binding check: a small manifest, snapshot and bindings, including ids the check must reject.
folders.out: Shared experiment inputs: the pre-import ontology snapshot, the benchmark tool manifest, the tool-to-ontology map and its coverage, and the per-tool ontology context lines given to the judge.
folders.pr: Source binding for the precision-and-recall test: each benchmark tool’s output classified as the user’s own record, external content or a registry, with a one-line reason.
folders.v2: Version-2 tool bindings: for each benchmark tool, the ontology effects it may cause and the class of each agent-visible parameter, with a reason; two independently authored passes.
folders.v2/out: The version-2 tool manifest: each benchmark tool’s name, description, impact and agent-visible parameters.
